items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: That was Tis Johnson band I worked with.

ctx.x: Asked him who he worked there with.

So who you worked there with? Huh? Who did you work there with? The Highman Park? Well, I worked there with the Baton Rouge band once. You know, for a football game. Just once I worked there. Well, I had the Salisand band. That was Tis Johnson band I worked with. But Tis had two of my men, you know. Tis was a guitar player, he sang. But he was scared big at times, because I got to know these fellas. He had a guitar player, yeah, where they could play, you know. So he used to hire me, you see. Then the fellas used…
Did he play like Louie? Yeah.
